decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding Giuseppe Persiani's spouse. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S5, D1S13) explicitly identifies 'Julie Margaret-Anne Beuth' as his wife within a narrative context. Document 2 (D2S1, D2S2, D2S18) explicitly identifies 'Fanny Tacchinardi Persiani' as his spouse, citing a marriage in 1832 and a letter exchange. Per the instruction to treat all source segments as fallible and to preserve distinct valid referents when competing assertions exist without external resolution, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the respective source texts.
